content:
In January I asked @Kenny Lau a question about
SymmetricPower via DMs -- essentially, I was asking about items that are in the ToDo.

And the reply was

maybe you can do the todo?

Then unfortunately I had a busy spring semester and did basically nothing substantial with Lean until last month.

I have now done a part of the todo items, namely:

  • Universal property:
    linear maps from Sym[R]^n M to N correspond to symmetric multilinear
    maps M ^ n to N.

In part, I used some work that Kenny had done here (at the time, he wrote

here's a definition of symmetric map, feel free to take any part of this code

)

I just made a draft PR.

The main thing I proved basically proved

def lift {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] :
    (M [Σ^ι]→ₗ[R] N) ≃ₗ[R] ((Sym[R] ι M) →ₗ[R] N)

I wondered if someone would have a look; the repo is here:

https://github.com/gmcninch-prof/mathlib4

in the branch symmetric-power-lift.

The new stuff past a few weeks old mathlib rebase is all found in:

Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/SymmetricMap.lean

and

Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorPower/Symmetric.lean

(the draft-PR description has links).

I was hoping to get comments before proceeding to other items on the
list (grading; relation with homogeneous multivariate polynomials).

Thanks in advance!

@George McNinch Thanks! I think this looks like a good start, and ready for some more detailed review. I suggest splitting this into 2 PRs: one adding symmetric maps, and the other adding the universal property.

@Johan Commelin Great, thanks! i've split into two PRs, though maybe I'll do a little more clean up before removing the draft-status.

They are:

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/41426
https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/41444
Great! Note that PRs in draft mode do not show up on the reviewer queues that we maintain. Just fyi.

Got it. Is it useful to let you know when I remove the "draft" status, here in the thread? I'd guess probably not -- I guess the queues will see the PRs once the draft status is turned off, which I'll probably do soon.

I've just done some more clean-up. Making sure I didn't break anything at the moment...
It should be picked up automatically, but feel free to ping here as well.
I responded to your comments in the repo. (Wasn't sure if I was supposed to do something about the awaiting-author label?)
you can remove the awaiting-author label by writing a comment which includes the line -awaiting-author
Hey, you should also read https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/how-to-contribute.html and the stuff that the "Welcome new contributor!" comment links to (which explains this)
Thanks - pretty sure I read that page last Aug. Guess I forgot some details. Will re-read, thanks.
